text: Bitcoin is holding around $76,300 today, up modestly and pushing the total crypto market past $2.6 trillion, but the calm on the surface hides a shakier picture underneath. The Fed just raised rates a quarter point to 3.75-4.00%, its first hike in three years, and the market barely blinked -- sentiment is still reading as greedy. The bigger tell is under the hood: actual spot trading volume dropped more than 12% while leveraged derivatives volume surged to nearly ten times that size, and institutions pulled over half a billion dollars out of Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs in a single day. Thin real buying, heavy leverage, and money quietly heading for the exits even as headline prices hold steady is the kind of setup that can snap fast once it moves -- expect more chop than a clean trend this week, with the risk skewed to the downside unless spot demand actually shows up.
